checkpoint_selection: Selection-fold thresholds above all bad bit-gate candidates, minimum0. Rank primary retention>=95%, min primary condition retention, primary correct sum, min secondary retention, secondary correct sum. Earliest tie. No calibration or future-test use.
calibration_rule: Per code presence threshold=max(0,nextafter(max presence score among calibration bad bit-gate accepts,+inf)), or0 if no bad; keep original BCH radius and bit likelihood gate. No recalibration after future evaluation.
candidate_criteria: Primary calibration and future evaluation each retain >=95% initial candidate300 correct in all conditions; future bad=0 and strictly fewer than initial candidate300. Research candidate only, no automatic working-policy replacement.
evaluation_disclosure: New rendered positive fingerprints and fresh natural photos; latent content was evaluated historically by original baseline5000, not untouched external data. Old batches remain inspected development data.
